LanguageData.ColonySummary_Failed: The Summary tab hit a problem and stops drawing until the game restarts. The log has the details.
LanguageData.ColonySummary_RowTip: Click to select this colonist and jump to them.
LanguageData.ColonySummary_SearchTip: Finds colonists by name, weapon or apparel.
LanguageData.ColonySummary_SortButtonTip: Sorted by {0}, {1}. Click a column heading to sort by it, or open this menu for every choice.
LanguageData.ColonySummary_Stat_ColonistsTip: Free colonists on every map, in caravans and in transporters, except babies.
LanguageData.ColonySummary_Stat_UncomfortableTip: Colonists outside their comfortable temperature range where they are.
LanguageData.ColonySummary_Column_IdeoTip: Click an icon to open the ideoligion.
LanguageData.ColonySummary_Column_HostilityTip: What each colonist does when enemies come near. Click to change it.
LanguageData.ColonySummary_Column_BleedingTip: Red shows the time until death by blood loss; yellow shows the bleed rate per day when there's no risk of bleeding out soon.
LanguageData.ColonySummary_Column_WeaponTip: Equipped weapons. Click one to open its info card.
LanguageData.ColonySummary_Column_ApparelTip: Worn apparel, outer layers first. Click one to open its info card. Sorts by the number of items worn.
LanguageData.ColonySummary_Column_SharpTip: Overall sharp armor, from apparel and body. The bar fills at 100%.
LanguageData.ColonySummary_Column_BluntTip: Overall blunt armor, from apparel and body. The bar fills at 100%.
LanguageData.ColonySummary_Column_HeatTip: Overall heat armor, from apparel and body. The bar fills at 100%.
LanguageData.ColonySummary_Column_ComfortTip: Comfortable temperature range, in green while the current temperature is inside it. Sorts by the lowest comfortable temperature.
